description: At the heart of Port of Spain, Woodford Square is a vibrant historic landmark where nature, culture and the story of Trinidad and Tobago come together. Surrounded by heritage buildings, the Square offers a glimpse into the capital's rich civic and cultural history. Known as the University of Woodford Square, it has been an important setting for public discourse, cultural activities and historical events. Visitors can explore the square and nearby heritage sites as part of a walking experience through the historic heart of Port of Spain. Check current opening arrangements, visitor access and any fees before travelling.
